description: Demo app (Midday's site design) running inside DesignLayer: an element selected on the live page, Layers panel on the left, Design inspector on the right.
alt: Midday's site design, rewritten to describe Design Layer, open in DesignLayer's dark editor. The serif headline 'The design layer for vibe-coded apps' is selected with an indigo outline and resize handles; Layers on the left shows the StartPage tree and the inspector on the right shows its size, fill and Hedvig Letters Serif typography.

description: Demo app (Midday's site design) on its own: the same page and scroll position as hero.jpg, editor collapsed with ⌘.
alt: The site on its own: Midday's editorial design with the serif headline 'The design layer for vibe-coded apps', a black Get started button and a Design Layer screenshot below.
note: Captured in the same page session right after hero.jpg. With the editor collapsed the app reflows to the full window width, so element positions differ from hero.jpg; scroll offset is unchanged.

description: The hero composition with DesignLayer's own chrome in its light theme.
alt: The hero composition with DesignLayer's own chrome in its light theme: the headline selected, Layers on the left and the inspector on the right.

description: A token picker open on the selection, listing Demo app (Midday's site design)'s own design tokens read from its globals.css and token manifest.
alt: A color token picker open in DesignLayer's inspector on the site's Get started button, listing the app's own HSL tokens from @midday/ui globals.css, such as background, foreground, card, primary and secondary, with light and dark swatches.

description: Holding Option/Alt over a second element draws the distances between it and the selection.
alt: The headline selected while Option is held over the Get started button; DesignLayer draws a red guide and the pixel distance between them.

description: The Responsive section: each Tailwind breakpoint with the design system's note on what it means and the file that owns it.
alt: DesignLayer's Responsive section for the headline: sm through 2xl breakpoints, each with what changes on the startpage and the file that owns it, the active breakpoint marked.

description: Several elements shift-selected at once, with align and distribute controls in the inspector.
alt: Three sibling feature links in the site's feature grid (Inspector, Comments, Changes) shift-selected together, each outlined, with DesignLayer's align, distribute and arrange controls in the inspector.

description: The Design system tab: libraries and design-system lint findings for the page.
alt: DesignLayer's Design system tab beside the homepage: two component libraries added from the project (src/components/sections and the integrations route components) and the DS lint section, which reports that no lint checker is installed.

description: The Design system tab's DS lint section after an audit: the project's own checkers' findings, grouped by rule.
alt: DesignLayer's DS lint section after an audit of the homepage's files: findings from the project's own shadcn/lint and ds-lint grouped by rule (off-scale values, inline styles, unknown classes, raw colors), each row naming the file and line.

description: The left panel's Design options tab, listing the on/off and value options found in the running app.
alt: DesignLayer's Design options tab listing the homepage's display switches (Announcement badge, Subtitle, Note under the button, Hero screenshot, Tilted hero screenshot), found in the live React tree; Subtitle is switched off and the hero now goes straight from the headline to the Get started button.

description: Canvas view (⇧1): every page of the app laid out as live frames on one board.
alt: DesignLayer canvas view: six pages of the site (home, about, agents, send to agent, shortcuts and comments) laid out side by side as live, fully rendered frames on a dark board.

description: Comment mode: numbered note pins on elements of the live page, with a note being written in the composer.
alt: The homepage in DesignLayer comment mode with numbered pins on the headline and the Open source badge, and a note composer open on the Get started button reading 'Point Get started at the install step.'

description: The Changes tab: notes and style edits in one numbered list, each marked Ready or Needs the agent, above the Send to agent button.
alt: DesignLayer's Changes tab beside the homepage, listing a gap edit on the hero call-to-action column marked Ready and three notes in one numbered list, above the Send to agent and Copy buttons, with the MCP endpoint showing a connected agent.
